title: Work Unit Accounting
description: Work Unit Accounting is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Counts real work units — commits, reviews, fixes — per peer. Work events are classified and counted with per-type weights into a ledger. It takes work events and produces ledger. Tunable parameters: per type. Guarantee: every counted unit is verifiable.

fields.mechanism: Work events are classified and counted with per-type weights into a ledger.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Quality Weighting
description: Quality Weighting is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Weights contributions by measured quality, not just volume. Quality signals — test pass rates, review acceptance — scale each unit's credit. It takes quality signals and produces weighted credit. Tunable parameters: 0.5–1.5×. Guarantee: volume alone never outranks quality.

fields.mechanism: Quality signals — test pass rates, review acceptance — scale each unit's credit.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Peer Review Scores
description: Peer Review Scores is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Lets peers rate each other's contributions directly. After a contribution lands, affected peers submit 1–5 ratings that feed the score. It takes ratings and produces review component. Tunable parameters: 1–5. Guarantee: self-ratings are never counted.

fields.mechanism: After a contribution lands, affected peers submit 1–5 ratings that feed the score.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Decay Over Time
description: Decay Over Time is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Lets old contributions fade so recent work matters most. Scores decay exponentially with a 180-day half-life; fresh work always outweighs old. It takes score history and produces decayed scores. Tunable parameters: half-life 180 d. Guarantee: decay never zeroes a score abruptly.

fields.mechanism: Scores decay exponentially with a 180-day half-life; fresh work always outweighs old.
fields.guarantees: decay never zeroes a score abruptly

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Sybil Resistance
description: Sybil Resistance is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Resists fake peers inflating each other's scores. New peers earn scoring weight slowly and mutual-rating cliques are detected and discounted. It takes peer graph and produces discounted cliques. Tunable parameters: trust ramp 90 d. Guarantee: cliques never keep full weight.

fields.mechanism: New peers earn scoring weight slowly and mutual-rating cliques are detected and discounted.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Milestone Bonuses
description: Milestone Bonuses is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Awards bonus credit for completing declared milestones. Milestones are declared in advance; completion verified by tests releases the bonus. It takes milestones and produces bonuses. Tunable parameters: per milestone. Guarantee: bonuses never pay for undeclared work.

fields.mechanism: Milestones are declared in advance; completion verified by tests releases the bonus.
fields.guarantees: bonuses never pay for undeclared work

title: Contribution Receipts
description: Contribution Receipts is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Issues a signed receipt for every scored contribution. Each scored unit mints a receipt the contributor can keep or show. It takes scored units and produces receipts. Tunable parameters: signed. Guarantee: receipts are never forgeable.

title: Dispute Flags
description: Dispute Flags is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Lets peers flag scoring errors for human review. Flags attach to the ledger entry with a reason; flagged entries pause until resolved. It takes flags and produces review queue. Tunable parameters: per entry. Guarantee: flagged entries never count twice.

title: Team Normalization
description: Team Normalization is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Normalizes scores across teams of different sizes. Team scores divide by active member count so small teams compete fairly. It takes team scores and produces normalized scores. Tunable parameters: per active member. Guarantee: inactive members never dilute.

title: Skill Tags
description: Skill Tags is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Tags contributions with the skills they demonstrate. Each work type maps to skill tags; peers accumulate a skill profile from their work. It takes work types and produces skill profiles. Tunable parameters: per type. Guarantee: tags always come from real work.

title: Streak Tracking
description: Streak Tracking is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Tracks consecutive active weeks as a consistency signal. A week counts as active with at least one scored unit; streaks break on gaps. It takes weekly activity and produces streaks. Tunable parameters: 1 unit/week. Guarantee: streaks never count partial weeks.

fields.mechanism: A week counts as active with at least one scored unit; streaks break on gaps.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Anonymous Baselines
description: Anonymous Baselines is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Compares each peer against an anonymized cohort, never named rivals. Cohorts of 20+ similar peers provide percentiles; no individual is identifiable. It takes cohort data and produces percentiles. Tunable parameters: n≥20. Guarantee: individuals are never exposed.

fields.mechanism: Cohorts of 20+ similar peers provide percentiles; no individual is identifiable.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Export Credentials
description: Export Credentials is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Exports a peer's score history as a portable credential. The export is signed and includes the full component breakdown. It takes peer record and produces credential file. Tunable parameters: signed JSON. Guarantee: exports never include others' data.

fields.mechanism: The export is signed and includes the full component breakdown.

provenance: Compiled from public technical literature and openly documented practice.

title: Score Appeals
description: Score Appeals is a scoring ability in the Peer Contribution Scoring database. Lets peers appeal a score with evidence within 14 days. Appeals attach evidence to the ledger entry; a reviewer adjusts or upholds. It takes appeals and produces rulings. Tunable parameters: 14 d window. Guarantee: appeals never change other peers' scores.
